name: Phone-free family dinners
summary: Hold phone-free family dinners with a cooking rotation and conversation prompts for your kids' ages.

onboarding.prompt: How many phone-free dinners a week?
onboarding.reaction: Great start. Small and steady works.

onboarding.prompt: Ages of kids at the table?

phases.name: Rotate
actions: Kids pick a prompt once a week

plan_blueprint.calendar: Dinner events on the chosen nights with that night's cook and a conversation prompt in the event notes.

approach_variants.habit: Same nights every week; family streak.
approach_variants.willpower: Family challenge: a full week of planned dinners.
approach_variants.time: Dinner time blocked on everyone's calendar.
approach_variants.reward: Family picks a shared treat after each streak of four weeks.
approach_variants.resource: First week sets up the phone basket, a rotation chart and easy meals.

guardrails: Kids' details stay private; only the dinner count is shared by default.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A missed dinner isn't made up. A missed week restarts with one dinner the next week.
